name: 二次的なワークスペース機能を選ぶMoreナビゲーションメニュー
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Linear navigation popover as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the reference crop exactly: a tall compact white rounded menu panel at approximately 221 by 274 pixels, with no surrounding sidebar or extra canvas. Keep the same width, corner radius, subtle shadow, row heights, left inset, icon-to-label gap, and restrained near-white surface.

Show these six rows in this exact order, each on one line: 「下書き」, 「イニシアチブ」, 「メンバー」, 「顧客」, 「チーム」, then after the thin horizontal divider, 「サイドバーをカスタマイズ」. Use compact Japanese interface typography similar in weight and size to the source, with charcoal labels and a clean readable Japanese sans-serif. Keep the first five rows evenly spaced. Preserve the final row in its own lower section with the source spacing.

Match the source icon concepts and positions: a page with pencil for drafts, a simple initiative symbol, a small people icon for members, a customer/contact card icon for customers, a square team/badge icon for teams, and an edit/sidebar icon for customization. Use the same small dark-gray line icon style, stroke weight, alignment and scale. Keep icons simple, clean and visually consistent.

The popover should fill the crop with only a few pixels of white margin around it. No extra rows, no app chrome, no title, no header, no pointer, no colored icons, no illustrations, no gradients, no added borders, and no English text. Preserve the reference component proportions and polished Linear menu appearance.
reviewNotes: Faithful Japanese Linear More menu with six entries in source order, matching compact white popover, five equal rows, separator and isolated sidebar customization row. Icons and text alignment closely track source; candidate 1126x1397 (0.8060:1) matches 221x274 (0.8066:1) within 0.1%; source/candidate visual comparison verified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
